about_the_game:
This demo is an early version of the new Space Grunts game currently being developed. This demo will be frequently updated in the next months as the game gets more content, improved game play, and slowly moves towards a full game.

You get to play through a couple of missions and see how the game is shaping up and what direction I'm moving with this! Feedback is welcome!

Space Grunts is a combination of turn-based tactics and fast paced arcade action.

Navigate your way through procedurally generated space stations, taking out enemies or using the shockwave of your rockets, grenades and other explosions to simply move those enemies out of the way on your path to the end goal: Restoring the Hyper Gates

Key features

  • Fast turn-based gameplay (made popular in the original Space Grunts).

  • Unique Time-Loop return system giving you an advantage every time you die.

  • Tactical weapon usage with weapons having a "spread pattern".

  • Explosive weapons generate shock-waves pushing/forcing entities around the map.

  • Procedurally generated.

Play the demo to try out the new turn based mechanics introduced in Space Grunts 3: pick missions, complete objectives, and try to escape before the Trigger Event happens.

You can follow the development on the Orangepixel Youtube channel, or hop on the Discord to give feedback and help shape the game with new ideas and features!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12 or newer
  • Processor: 2.0 ghz Dual Core
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD3000 or higher with OpenGL 2.1 support
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL supported sound card

short_description: A turn-based roguelike where you travel between space stations fixing the Ooze-infected Hyper-Gates. Using time-loop technology to give yourself an advantage after every death. Play it at the speed of an arcade game, or take your time and think about your next step.
